verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the Mesh documentation. The docs pages are also served as raw .md files, and their frontmatter declares agentTools.projectIndex pointing back to llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. An OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is also retrievable without authentication. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent consumes these docs effectively, and no first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
